method: Built-in image generation and edits; original fantasy raster art; reference Bomb Buddies art v3 / Pip v4.

prompts.revision-gear: Repair this sprite atlas for game use. Preserve EXACTLY all 24 items in SAME reading order, same designs and materials. Output EXACT6columns x4rows with EQUAL SQUARE cells, canvas1536x1024. Every icon must occupy only CENTER60% of its own cell, with20% completely transparent padding on all four sides. SHRINK all artwork substantially. Entirely isolated icons, no detached fragments from neighbors, no weapon or staff crosses any cell boundary. No painted frames, no text or gridlines. Transparent alpha background. Critical: each icon FULLY visible, no cut-off sword tips, staffs, bow or ornaments. Keep rich painted raster medieval style.

prompts.revision-enemies-c: Re-layout and repair this enemy sprite sheet. Preserve six characters and their TWO poses (idle and attack), but arrange EXACT4columns x3rows of equal SQUARE cells, canvas1536x1152. Reading order: row1 fire imp idle, fire imp attack, basalt lava golem idle, basalt lava golem punch; row2 orange baby dragon idle, baby dragon breathing fire, blue ice spirit idle, ice spirit casting; row3 snow warrior idle, snow warrior axe attack, ice witch idle, ice witch staff casting. Every full body AND all magic must fit inside CENTER60% of cell. Keep wide completely transparent gutters, no overlapping neighbors, NO detached fragments, no clipped helmets or staffs, no giant ice waves. Make effects COMPACT close to hands. Same character identity, consistent scale within pairs, rich fantasy raster material, not vector. No text or grid lines. Transparent background.
